basic_details.job_title: WAMUL Graduate Apprentice Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: West Assam Milk Producers' Co-operative Union Ltd (WAMUL), Purabi Dairy, Panjabari, Guwahati, is engaging Graduate Apprentices (NATS) for 2026-27 at a stipend of Rs. 12,300/- per month for a training period of 1 (one) year. Candidates with any graduation along with ITI who passed in 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 or 2025 should email their CV to [email protected] by 4 December 2026, with the subject line "Apprentice for Graduate level".

how_to_apply: Register at https://nats.education.gov.in/student_type.php. The notice says all interested candidates are mandatorily required to do this.
Keep your Enrollment ID, which you must carry to the venue when called for interview.

Send it on or before 4 December 2026.
Wait for contact by mail, as shortlisted candidates will be connected through mail only.
Documents named in the notice: CV and NATS Enrollment ID (to be carried to the interview venue). The notice gives no photo or file-size specification.

content_sections.heading: About WAMUL
content_sections.text: West Assam Milk Producers' Co-operative Union Ltd (WAMUL) runs Purabi Dairy at Panjabari, Guwahati. The notice invites apprentices for the financial year 2026-27 under the Apprenticeship Act 1961 as amended in 1973, 1986 and 2014, with reference to the Board of Practical Training (BOPT), Ministry of HRD, Govt. of India. The engagement is as an apprentice (NATS).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who passed in the year 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 or 2025 are eligible for this Apprenticeship Training. Candidates must also register at the NATS portal and carry their Enrollment ID to the venue when called for interview. Candidates should check the official notice for any further eligibility details. The notice states that postgraduate candidates need not apply.

rows.qualification_required: Any Graduate along with ITI from an NCVT/SCVT approved institute

content_sections.text: The duration of the Apprenticeship Training is 1 (one) year. The notice names no allowances or other benefits.

Keep your Enrollment ID, which you must carry to the venue when called for interview. Part 2: Application to WAMUL Prepare your CV and keep the mail ID mentioned in it up to date. Email the CV to [email protected] with the subject line "Apprentice for Graduate level". Send it on or before 4 December 2026. Wait for contact by mail, as shortlisted candidates will be connected through mail only. Documents named in the notice: CV and NATS Enrollment ID (to be carried to the interview venue). The notice gives no photo or file-size specification.
